title: Deep Learning for Medical Image Classification
publication_venue: IEEE International Conference on Medical Imaging
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to medical image classification using transfer learning with ResNet50 architecture. We achieve 94% accuracy on chest X-ray datasets, demonstrating the potential of deep learning in clinical decision support systems.

title: Real-time Object Detection for Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: We propose a lightweight neural network architecture for real-time object detection that achieves 60 FPS on embedded systems while maintaining competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art models.
